subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Comunicar, para públicos variados, em diversos contextos, resultados de análises, pesquisas e/ou experimentos, elaborando e/ou interpretando textos, gráficos, tabelas, símbolos, códigos, sistemas de classificação e equações, por meio de diferentes linguagens, mídias, tecnologias digitais de informação e comunicação (TDIC), de modo a participar e/ou promover debates em torno de temas científicos e/ou tecnológicos de relevância sociocultural e ambiental.

components.description_pt: Comunicar descobertas científicas usando formatos apropriados ao público e propósito
components.description_en: Communicate scientific findings using formats appropriate to the audience and purpose
components.cc_component_description: Communicate scientific findings using formats appropriate to the audience and purpose

components.description_pt: Interpretar informações científicas apresentadas através de diferentes linguagens, mídias e tecnologias digitais
components.description_en: Interpret scientific information presented through different languages, media, and digital technologies
components.cc_component_description: Synthesize information from multiple complex texts and reliable media sources to support a scientific claim

components.description_pt: Selecionar formato apropriado de comunicação para transmitir ideias científicas ou soluções de design
components.description_en: Select an appropriate communication format to convey scientific ideas or design solutions to a specific audience
components.cc_component_description: Select an appropriate communication format to convey scientific ideas or design solutions to a specific audience

components.description_pt: Participar ou promover debates sobre tópicos socioculturais ou ambientais relevantes científica e tecnologicamente
components.description_en: Participate in or promote debates on scientifically and technologically relevant sociocultural or environmental topics
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate both negative and positive consequences of human-driven environmental changes on biodiversity and ecosystems

cc_matches.description: Communicate information or design ideas and/or solutions with others in oral and/or written forms using models, drawings, writing, or numbers that provide detail about scientific ideas, practices, and/or design ideas.
Compare and/or combine across complex texts and/or other reliable media to support the engagement in other scientific and/or engineering practices.

Human activities have significantly altered the biosphere, sometimes damaging or destroying natural habitats and causing the extinction of other species. But changes to Earth’s environments can have different impacts (negative and positive) for different living things.
